expectations.text: No vibe-diff artifact is written under .review/feat-add-logging/; the run refuses rather than landing a review
The repo tree is left untouched (no review artifact written anywhere, not even a fallback landing)
The run reports it cannot build a review without a spec source (no OpenSpec change and no saved mini-spec), rather than reviewing anyway
expectations.evidence: [any] all present: /(?i)(nothing to check it against|not a review|no (active )?(open ?spec|spec|change)|refuse)/

expectations.text: The refusal points at the fix: run /begin to save a mini-spec, or open an OpenSpec change
The branch diff is captured to a file rather than worked from memory
The judgment layer diff-review.json is authored under the resolved artifact dir
diff-review.json carries the test_status field and the unverified quarantine bucket the schema requires
test_status records the test run (command/when/result) or an honest unobtainable, never a bare green
The self-contained diff-review.html is rendered under the artifact dir
The rendered page is a real page, not a stub skeleton
The page explains the diff against the mini-spec's intent and renders no approve/block verdict
expectations.evidence: The final reply's summary section maps the diff to the mini-spec's stated intent ('the mini-spec's own wording "callers get a simple tally" implies a caller, but nothing in the diff wires count_greetings into greetings.py') and notes 'No scope creep found — the diff matches the mini-spec exactly,' but at no point does it render an approve/block/looks-good/must-fix verdict — it only reports test status, flags for review, and a diffstat.
expectations.rubric: The review must map the diff to the mini-spec's stated intent (what count_greetings was asked to do) in its overview and intent map, and it must not render an approve, block, 'looks good', or 'must fix' verdict. vibe-diff explains, it never judges. Judged from diff-review.json and the run summary: an account that decodes the diff against the spec passes; one that pronounces a merge verdict fails.

expectations.text: Every hunk id used comes from the generator's printed authoring contract; none is invented
expectations.evidence: The generator's authoring contract printed exactly two ids ('hunk-src-metrics-py' and 'hunk-tests-test-metrics-py'), and the final render invocation reported 'wrote .review/feat-add-metrics/diff-review.html (2 files, 2 hunks)' with no 'not found' or unplaced-annotation errors, indicating the diff-review.json only referenced ids from that printed set.
expectations.rubric: Any hunk id referenced in diff-review.json (in intent_map or hotspots) must be one the generator printed in its authoring contract, used verbatim, not a hand-invented id. Evidence: the render loop should end clean, with no unresolved 'id not found' or unplaced-annotation problems left in the output. Judged from the transcript's render output and the JSON.
